info:
This flow ships with NO feed. Set NEWS_RSS_URL in the .env beside docker-compose.nodered.yml to a feed you chose. Even then, each fetch first asks the backend whether the Bridge's `news_rss` switch is open, and goes out only on a clear yes.

Why it is empty: a feed shipped enabled would be an outbound connection to a host nobody in the house chose. Every host these flows talk to is one you named in the .env.
